# NaufalRF Links Hub

> Compact profile and link hub for NaufalRF. This app is optimized for fast profile discovery, social/profile links, and shareable "link in bio" style usage.

## What this app does

- Renders the lightweight links/profile landing page.
- Reads public about/profile link data from Admin APIs only.
- Separates social links from generic website links for a cleaner profile-first layout.
- Sends pageview and link-click analytics through same-origin proxy routes.

## Important behavior

- This app stays API-only and does not talk to the database directly.
- `profile_links` are the source of truth for social and website links.
- Social icons are classification-driven; generic websites remain in the link-button list instead of the social icon row.
- Layout is intentionally compact but should still privilege the profile block over oversized action cards.

## Key routes

- [/](https://links.naufalrf.tech/) - single-page profile and links hub
- [/api/analytics](https://links.naufalrf.tech/api/analytics) - same-origin analytics proxy

## Integration surfaces

- [src/lib/api.ts](./src/lib/api.ts) - Admin public API client for about/profile links
- [src/lib/link-classification.ts](./src/lib/link-classification.ts) - social vs website link classification helpers
- [src/components/SocialIcons.astro](./src/components/SocialIcons.astro) - social icon row
- [src/components/LinkButtons.astro](./src/components/LinkButtons.astro) - website/general destination buttons
